free_tier.stated: 10 GB free, up to 50 GB with bonuses. 4 GB per file free. Pro 1 TB, 30% off.

egress.terms: Direct-link egress is metered and ad-gated on free; Pro removes ads and gives 1 TB with standard transfer speeds.

tooling: No rclone backend (AList has a MediaFire driver). No WebDAV. REST API exists but is oriented at upload/share, not bulk sync.
chaining: 10-50 GB units with no rclone backend means the shard count for 20 TB is 400+ accounts against an unaudited REST API. Economically absurd.
limits_note: per-object: 4 GB/file free. Bonus scheme caps at 50 GB.
reliability_note: 100M users, stable, but tuned for sharing rather than storage; free tier is ad-supported.

evidence.proved: '10GB for free. Up to 50GB free with bonuses'; '10GB Free/Up to 4GB per file'; '1 TB of storage' on Pro
